theme: An open day, four days out from Croatia.
greeting: A wide-open Friday in St. Pete, the girls home with you and Mike. Nothing is on the calendar anywhere — which is exactly the room the pre-Croatia list has been waiting for, before you lose signal aboard next week.

needsAttention.title: Refundable SUV as backup
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 20–Oct 5 rental hedge reaches its decision point Monday: book a refundable Full-Size SUV at TPA unless Mike's car is confirmed en route to Florida. Mike + Dan Board, overdue Aug 28.

needsAttention.title: Confirm bags on the Croatia ticket
needsAttention.detail: The issued ticket shows zero checked bags. Verify the allowance on Eurowings Discover's own site with the record locator and buy bags online before Monday's departure — counter fees run far higher. Overdue Aug 25.

needsAttention.title: Book the last Cavtat night
needsAttention.detail: The Sat Sept 19 Cavtat hotel and the noon marina transfer from ACI Komolac have to be locked from dry land before you board Monday, when connectivity drops. Overdue Aug 26.

needsAttention.title: St Pete landing gap, Sept 20–22
needsAttention.detail: Two nights in St Pete between the Croatia landing and Tuesday's 3 PM kid pickup are still unbooked. Overdue Aug 25.

flagged.title: Experian monthly statement
flagged.detail: Your September credit statement is available — routine, worth a glance.

flagged.title: care.com password reset
flagged.detail: A password-reset email arrived from care.com; open it only if you requested it.

inbox.noise: Everything else is newsletters and promos — Press Herald, HBO Max, Airbnb, MINI, and political fundraising.
inbox.clear: Nothing is waiting on your reply.

recipe.title: Chestnut and Pancetta Salad
recipe.why: Early autumn brings the first chestnuts and hearty greens worth warming with pancetta.

tasks.title: Buy EU plug adapters + a US power strip

acts.line: The calendar is empty from the first coffee — no meetings, no calls.
Still nothing on the books; a rare uninterrupted stretch to spend as you choose.
A quiet night in St. Pete with the four girls at home.
